facts.text: Students are guaranteed on-campus housing for all four years and are required to live on campus unless commuting from within a 50-mile radius.

sources.title: Housing - Connecticut College
sources.quote: You are guaranteed housing for all four years.

sources.title: Housing - Connecticut College
sources.quote: Students are required to live in residence at the College unless they are living with their parents, guardians, spouse or dependents within a 50-mile radius of the campus.
